page.title: Cookie Policy
page.subtitle: We use cookies to improve your experience

intro.text: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and the types of cookies we use. By using our app and services, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

what_are.title: What Are Cookies?
content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device
They help us remember your preferences and settings
Improve user experience and app performance

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Enhance app features and remember preferences

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how the app is used

usage.title: How We Use Cookies
content: Keep you logged in during sessions

control.title: Controlling Cookies
content: You can manage cookie preferences in app settings
Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies
Disabling cookies may limit some features
You can delete cookies at any time
